data.name: Outrigger Canoe Charter
data.headline: 1 Hour • Ages 5+ • “Hoe Ka Wa'a!" (Paddle the Canoe!)
data.description: Enjoy the thrill of surfing a wave on an outrigger canoe in Waikīkī. This private canoe charter allows up to 6 people to paddle and surf together under the guidance of certified canoe captains.
data.highlights:
- Private 1-hour canoe charter for your group or family.
- Guided by certified canoe captains.
- Suitable for all swimming and paddling abilities.
- Fun for families with children aged 5+
data.itinerary:
- Paddle out to the surfbreak under the guidance of your experienced Waikīkī Beachboy canoe captains.
- Catch waves in an outrigger canoe with your group or family.
- Experience the thrill of surfing a wave!

meeting_point.address: Royal Hawaiian Hotel, 2259 Kalākaua Ave., Honolulu, HI 96815

data.what_is_included:
- Canoe and paddles
- Guidance from certified canoe captains
- Life jackets available upon request
data.what_is_not_included:
- Life jackets or flotation devices for children (must be provided by guardians)
- Reef safe sunscreen
- Towels
- Storage lockers for personal items
data.what_to_bring:
- Towel
- Reef safe sunscreen
- Flotation device for children (if required)
data.cancellation_summary: Submit cancellation requests 48 hours prior for a refund.
data.cancellation_notes:
If you wish to change or cancel your booking, please submit your request via e-mail to info@waikikibeachservices.com at least 48 hours before an activity/rental. No-shows or cancellation requests received within 48 hours will not be eligible for refund.

Please allow up to 10 business days for refunds to process between banking institutions.

Mahalo for booking with **Waikīkī Beach Services at the Royal Hawaiian**. Please read below important information.

#Check-In

Please check-in at least 10–15 minutes before your booked time at our service counter located on the pool deck of the Royal Hawaiian Hotel at 2259 Kalākaua Ave., Honolulu, HI. 96815.  

Find your way to the beach by taking the surfboard lined public beach access walkway that is located between The Cheesecake Factory (restaurant) and The Outrigger Waikīkī on the Beach (hotel) on Kalākaua Ave. Continue down this path until you have reached the sand. Our service counter is located on your right.

#Things to Remember

Please bring your own towel and sunscreen and leave valuables at home. Please note that personal belongings should not be left unattended at any time on the beach or pool. Bringing money or non-essential personal belongings to the beach or pool is highly discouraged. The pool and beach staff is not responsible for guests' personal belongings. 


All guests must e-fill the emailed Waiver Form prior to the activity and will have their temperature scanned before the activity date/time.

Should you have any questions, please feel free to contact us.

We look forward to seeing you.

data.check_in_details: Check in at least 10-15 minutes before your booking at the service counter.
data.special_requirements:
- Children must be accompanied by a parent or guardian during the ride.
- Guardians must provide a personal flotation device for their children.
data.extras:
- Photos and video available for purchase
- All canoe captains are CPR and lifeguard certified.
data.health_and_safety_notes:
Your safety and the safety of our staff are our highest priorities. All participants, including minors, must complete an electronic liability waiver before participating in any Waikīkī Beach Services activity or rental. A link to the waiver will be included in your confirmation email. We recommend completing all waivers before your scheduled activity to help expedite check-in.

Some activities and rentals have minimum age requirements. Please provide accurate participant ages when booking. Guests who do not meet the age requirement or appear to be under the influence of drugs or alcohol will not be permitted to participate, and no refund will be issued.

Please do not leave personal belongings unattended on the beach or at the pool. Limited storage is available for shoes and towels, but valuables should be left in a secure location. Waikīkī Beach Services and its staff are not responsible for lost, stolen, or damaged personal property.
data.disclaimers: - Safety first: if ocean conditions are unsafe, tours may be rescheduled or canceled.
data.faqs:
- **Is the activity suitable for beginners?** Yes, all swimming and paddling abilities are welcome.
- **Can children participate?** Yes, children aged 5+ are welcome, but a parent or guardian must be present to hold them and provide a flotation device.
